{
 "path": "/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL-openclaw-luna6-medium-seq0/frozen/held-out/play/users/u092/system/state/workspace/programs/task-49ef4fb1.py",
 "content": "def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    points = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, v in enumerate(row) if v == 1]
    if len(points) < 2:
        return out
    # The markers lie on a down-right diagonal at a regular interval.
    points.sort()
    dr = points[1][0] - points[0][0]
    dc = points[1][1] - points[0][1]
    if dr <= 0 or dc <= 0 or dr != dc:
        return out
    if any((b[0] - a[0], b[1] - a[1]) != (dr, dc) for a, b in zip(points, points[1:])):
        return out
    r, c = points[-1]
    while r + dr < len(out) and c + dc < len(out[0]):
        r += dr
        c += dc
        out[r][c] = 2
    return out
"
}
